phases.name: Setup
phases.goal: Repo, data and dense reference numbers ready

cards.title: Repo, uv lock file, pytest, GitHub Actions
cards.done_when: CI runs an empty test suite

cards.title: Colab notebook skeleton: Drive mount, install from lock file, GPU in manifest
cards.done_when: Same notebook runs on T4 and A100

cards.title: Cache C4 calibration (128 × 2,048 tokens) and WikiText-2 validation and test splits
cards.done_when: Cached files hashed in the manifest

cards.title: Dense Qwen3-0.6B validation and test perplexity on Mac and T4
cards.done_when: Numbers recorded

cards.title: Setup gate
cards.done_when: All checks decided: go or fallback applied

checks.label: Dense 0.6B perplexity, Mac vs. T4
checks.fallback: Fix the evaluation code before anything else

cards.title: Adapt Wanda to Qwen3; run Wanda at 50% on 0.6B (the quality bar)
cards.done_when: Bar recorded: validation and test perplexity, 7 zero-shot tasks

cards.title: Adapt FLAP scoring and bias compensation to grouped-query attention
cards.done_when: FLAP at its own allocation matches the adapted reference

cards.title: Uniform Wanda-sp on Qwen3
cards.done_when: Matches its reference at a uniform cut

cards.title: Pruner from a per-layer plan (all four strategies) + loader
cards.done_when: Save-and-reload gives identical perplexity

cards.title: Device estimator from a plan: weight bytes, bytes per token, prompt FLOPs; estimated tokens/s for a device target
cards.done_when: Weight bytes match file size within 1%

cards.title: Speed meter on M4 (Mac GPU) and T4; fix speed settings (Q3); record each machine as a device target
cards.done_when: Repeat runs vary < 5% on each machine

cards.title: Check the speed estimate against measured speed on M4 and T4, ~10 plans (A6, A8)
cards.done_when: Rank correlation and % error recorded per machine

cards.title: Layer-local probes for all four strategies; compare with full evaluation (A1)
cards.done_when: Rank correlation recorded

cards.title: FLAP and uniform Wanda-sp pruned to the bar (A7)
cards.done_when: Savings at the bar recorded

cards.title: Wanda at 50% on Qwen3-1.7B: production bar
cards.done_when: Bar recorded for 1.7B

cards.title: One agent round wired by hand: table → LLM → 3 candidates → evaluate
cards.done_when: Valid JSON; candidates evaluate

cards.title: Feasibility gate
cards.done_when: All checks decided: go or fallback applied

checks.label: References reproduce (1.1–1.3)
checks.fallback: Reimplement fluctuation metric and bias compensation (A4); at most half a day

checks.label: Probes rank like full evaluation (A1)
checks.fallback: Probes as hints only; more full evaluations per round

checks.label: Speed estimate ranks like measured speed on M4 and T4 (A6)
checks.fallback: Measure tokens/s on the accepted plan every 5 rounds

checks.label: Speed estimate close enough for phone estimates (A8)
checks.go_if: Within ~25% of measured speed on both machines
checks.fallback: Report phone targets as memory fit only

checks.label: Structured pruning reaches the bar with a real saving (A7)
checks.go_if: FLAP at the bar saves ≥ 5% of weight memory
checks.fallback: Continue; headline becomes how the agent mixes strategies

checks.label: Bar is not trivial
checks.fallback: Weaker bar only if structured pruning reaches it at > 30% saving; fix before phase 4

cards.title: State types per ARCHITECTURE.md §4.3 and §7
cards.done_when: Type-checked

cards.title: Validator: structure, step-size and budget rules
cards.done_when: Unit tests for every rule

cards.title: Agent client: prompt, JSON parsing, LLM cache, cost ledger
cards.done_when: Cached rerun costs $0

cards.title: LangGraph graph with all nodes and edges
cards.done_when: Graph compiles; each edge tested with a fake LLM

cards.title: Parallel candidate evaluation (≤ 3), sequential fallback
cards.done_when: Same results in parallel and sequential mode

cards.title: Gate: quality bar, 15% per-step limit, largest saving wins
cards.done_when: Gate unit tests

cards.title: Rollback to any earlier accepted plan
cards.done_when: Restores exact earlier perplexity

cards.title: Checkpoints (SQLite + plan JSON) and decision log (JSONL)
cards.done_when: Log schema test

cards.title: Agent instructions v1: neutral strategy descriptions, objective stated
cards.done_when: Reviewed against the ADR-007 neutrality rule

cards.title: Choose and pin the agent LLM (Q1)
cards.done_when: Pinned model id in config

cards.title: Device target: feasibility check with early warning, stop at target, final warning with closest plan and gap
cards.done_when: Unit tests with an impossible, an already-met and a reachable target

cards.title: Midpoint gate
cards.done_when: All checks decided: go or fallback applied

checks.label: End-to-end run on 0.6B
checks.go_if: ≥ 1 ACCEPT and ≥ 1 ROLLBACK, under $5 and 2 h
checks.fallback: One candidate per round (descoping step 3); retry the next morning

cards.title: Tuning runs on 0.6B (~8–10, queued overnight; Mac and Colab in parallel); compare with FLAP and uniform Wanda-sp at the bar
cards.done_when: Each run logged with instruction version

cards.title: Neutrality check on every instruction change
cards.done_when: Diff reviewed

cards.title: Kill-and-resume test
cards.done_when: Resumed run matches an uninterrupted run

cards.title: ShortGPT pruned to the bar
cards.done_when: Savings recorded

cards.title: Report writer: quality, memory, speed, strategy counts, rationale log
cards.done_when: Report builds from a tuning run

cards.title: Demo notebook on 0.6B with pre-run report (Q2)
cards.done_when: Runs top to bottom on T4

cards.title: Freeze gate
cards.done_when: All checks decided: go or fallback applied

checks.label: Instructions frozen at a tagged commit by end of D6
checks.fallback: Freeze anyway at end of D6; report results below FLAP as they are (S4)

cards.title: FLAP, uniform Wanda-sp, ShortGPT pruned to the 1.7B bar
cards.done_when: Plans saved

cards.title: Production run on Qwen3-1.7B, frozen instructions, no device target
cards.done_when: Run complete; log and plan saved

cards.title: Two device-target runs on 1.7B: one reachable within the bar, one not
cards.done_when: Reachable run stops at target; other ends with final warning and gap

cards.title: Final evaluation: test perplexity, 7 zero-shot tasks, MMLU
cards.done_when: Scores recorded

cards.title: Memory and tokens/s for every method on M4 and T4
cards.done_when: Measurement per method per machine

cards.title: Score S1–S4 and prediction P1; device reports for 4.3
cards.done_when: Table in the report

cards.title: Report, README with reproduction steps, demo
cards.done_when: Fresh clone reproduces the report from saved logs

cards.title: Buffer (keep D9 free)
cards.done_when: D9 unused or spent on slips

cards.title: Final gate
cards.done_when: All checks decided: go or fallback applied

checks.label: Report reproduces from the README
checks.go_if: Fresh clone gives the same tables

cards.title: Optional: one-time 8-/4-bit weight quantization of the final model; same checks on M4 and T4
cards.done_when: Test perplexity, memory, tokens/s recorded
